title: Questions by inversion, to close the door
summary: You can ask a question just with your voice (Tu peux confirmer ?), or more formally by swapping the person and verb, joined with a dash (Peux-tu confirmer ?). You also learn fermer (to close), la porte, and how to learn nouns together with their le/la.
points: Two ways to ask: rising tone (Tu veux ?) or inversion (Veux-tu ?). Inversion is more proper. Tone is common in everyday speech.
Inverted questions are written with a dash: Peux-tu…? Veux-tu…?
Always learn a noun with its 'the': learn 'la porte', not 'porte (feminine)'. Ask natives 'How do you say THE door?'
con-/com- is a common Latin prefix: con + firmer. fermer (to close) is related to 'firm'.
The French r is made in the throat: la porte.
commander, recommander, demander all share a base meaning 'hand' (la main).

drills.en: Can you close the door a little?
drills.fr: Peux-tu fermer la porte un peu ?
